# Connectome_Topology_Profiling

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for characterizing the structural and functional connectivity patterns of brain networks using graph-theoretic metrics derived from connectome embeddings. Provides a framework for translating biological network topology into computational graph structures suitable for TCC-based processing.
